title: iproute2 v2.6.39→v3.0.0 tagged-release boundary for ip netns

date.notes: v3.0.0 tag commit timestamp; v2.6.39 is dated 2011-06-29.

claims_extracted.claim: The v2.6.39 tagged `ip/` tree does not contain ipnetns.c, while v3.0.0 contains ip/ipnetns.c and the named `ip netns` implementation.
claims_extracted.locator: adjacent tag tree comparison: v2.6.39 ip/ directory versus v3.0.0 ip/ipnetns.c
claims_extracted.notes: Path-presence boundary checked directly against the tagged trees.

claims_extracted.claim: The processless-netns introduction commit 0dc34c7713bb7055378fe5cbc720d63d0db572a1 is after v2.6.39 and an ancestor of the v3.0.0 tag commit ce691fb5ce78b2c75243c60a757a3990ae09681c.
claims_extracted.locator: Git commit ancestry / compare; v2.6.39 tag object; v3.0.0 tag commit
claims_extracted.notes: This establishes v3.0.0 as the first tagged iproute2 release snapshot containing the command family because v2.6.39 is the immediately preceding release tag.

notes: This proves the first tagged-release/source-snapshot boundary. It does not prove the date or channel of the first independently distributed public tarball, package adoption, or first real-world use.
